lines.en: Amara, I predict that by the end of the century, this library will have become fully digital.
lines.pt: Amara, eu prevejo que, até o fim do século, esta biblioteca terá se tornado totalmente digital.

lines.en: Nora, I doubt it. By then, people will have returned to paper, because screens tire the eyes.
lines.pt: Nora, duvido. Até lá, as pessoas terão voltado ao papel, porque as telas cansam a vista.

lines.en: By next year, we will have moved the archive to a database, so nothing gets lost.
lines.pt: Até o ano que vem, teremos transferido o acervo para um banco de dados, para nada se perder.

lines.en: By the time the work ends, the staff will have scanned thousands of pages.
lines.pt: Quando o trabalho acabar, a equipe terá digitalizado milhares de páginas.

lines.en: Will they have finished before the new building opens? I hope so, because the old one is too small.
lines.pt: Eles terão terminado antes de o novo prédio abrir? Espero que sim, porque o antigo é pequeno demais.

lines.en: By then the city will have grown, and the library will have added a floor for children.

lines.en: By 2050 the climate will have changed, so the reading rooms will have been moved upstairs, away from the river.

lines.en: Maybe. Before that, I will have saved enough money to buy a flat near the docks.

lines.en: Yes, and by then I will have written my book about the port, if the research goes well.

lines.en: I will have read it by Christmas, I promise. And by the end of the century, a new generation will have found it online!
lines.pt: Eu o terei lido até o Natal, prometo. E até o fim do século, uma nova geração o terá encontrado online!

teach.goal: Ponte português → inglês com palavras úteis.
solo: Peça uma frase pessoal com 2 das palavras.

Aluno diz em português um uso real, depois a palavra em inglês.
extra90: Cada aluno escolhe a palavra mais útil e explica por quê.

facts.label: Futuro perfeito
facts.sub: Concluído antes de um momento futuro: By then, I will have finished. Pergunta: Will you have…? Negativa: won’t have. Muito usado com by.

facts.label: Terá feito
facts.sub: Use will have + particípio para algo concluído antes de um momento futuro: By Friday, I will have finished. Em português, “terei terminado”. A forma não muda com o sujeito.

facts.label: Até
facts.sub: By + tempo costuma acompanhar o futuro perfeito: by next year, by then, by the end of the century. By indica o limite: antes ou até esse momento, não depois.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Will have + participle talks about something finished before a future time.
“By 2050 it will have changed” means it changes after 2050.
items.why: It means the change happens before 2050.

items.s: By + time often goes with the future perfect.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Will have + participle talks about something finished before a future… → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
“By 2050 it will have changed” means it changes after 2050. → Falso (It means the change happens before 2050.)
By + time often goes with the future perfect. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: The library of the future · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a windy afternoon beside the docks in Liverpool. Gil and Tom are in a large public library. Old maps of the port hang on the walls. Students read quietly at long tables. The two friends look at a new screen near the stairs. They begin to talk about the future of books.

“Tom, I predict that by the end of the century, this library will have become fully digital.” says Gil. “Gil, I doubt it. By then, people will have returned to paper, because screens tire the eyes.” says Tom. “By next year, we will have moved the archive to a database, so nothing gets lost.” says Gil.
